title: Policy Artifact
description: One candidate handover policy moving through the pipeline: trained -> aggregated -> gated -> (promoted | rejected). The promoted-policy store accepts only artifacts with gate.verdict == "promote". Frozen per issue #1 — changing this schema requires sign-off from both George and Raneem.

version.description: Unique candidate version, e.g. v0.3.1. The xApp logs this as active_policy_version after hot-load.

weights_ref.description: Path or URI to the checkpoint file this artifact describes.

radio_map.description: Which twin radio map the policy trained against (issue #6 stages).

twin_commit.description: Git commit of the twin used for training.

scenarios.description: Scenario config names used during training.

radio_model.description: Twin radio model. legacy = v1 twin (total-power RSRP, 1 s step, RSRP-threshold HO failure); phy-v2 = per-RE RSRP + SINR/interference, 100 ms step, 3GPP RLF/HOF (pipeline/twin/phy.py, sim.py). Absent = legacy.

fading.description: Small-scale fading modes used during training (domain randomization when more than one). Absent = off.

l3_k.description: 3GPP L3 filterCoefficient k (TS 38.331 5.5.3.2) applied to the policy's RSRP observations; 0 = unfiltered.

obs_filter.description: Measurement filtering the policy observes. Absent = unfiltered.

provenance.description: Present for federated candidates; null for single-client training runs.

aggregation.description: Aggregation method that produced this candidate.

gate.description: Safety-gate result. verdict == "pending" until the gate has run; the store refuses anything but "promote".

worst_case_score.description: Worst-case performance score over the adversarial scenario suite.

threshold.description: Pre-registered SLA threshold the worst-case score was checked against.

scenario_suite.description: Name/version of the adversarial scenario suite used.
